disclaimer_short: Educational guidance to prepare for a clinician visit. Not a medical diagnosis.
privacy_badge: Your answers are not stored on our servers
data_deleted_notice: All session data has been deleted from your browser.
data_not_saved_notice: Your answers live in browser memory only and are not saved on this device.

landing.promise: A personalised map of what matters most for YOUR PCOS.
landing.sub_promise: Because no two women have the same body, symptoms, or goals. Answer a few questions about your unique health context to get a structured roadmap for your next doctor visit.
landing.what_we_collect: What we ask about: your anatomical context, symptoms and daily impact, metabolic indicators, and wellbeing.
landing.what_we_never_do: What we never do: we never sell your data, never log raw health inputs, never prescribe medications, and never give automated diagnoses.
landing.consent_checkbox: I understand that MahilaSakhi provides educational guidance for doctor visits and does not replace medical care. I consent to proceed.

context.title: Your Reproductive & Anatomical Context
context.subtitle: Care navigation begins with understanding your unique body. We never assume every person has a cycle or uterus.
context.meno_natural: Natural menopause (12+ months since last period)
context.hormones_label: Are you currently using hormonal medication?
context.pregnancy_postpartum: Currently pregnant or within 12 months postpartum
context.goal_later: May want children in the future

symptoms.title: Symptom Severity & Daily Impact
symptoms.subtitle: Select how noticeable each symptom is right now, and how much it affects your daily confidence or comfort.
symptoms.impact_question: How much does this affect your daily life or confidence?

facial_hair.title: Facial or body hair growth (Hirsutism)
facial_hair.desc: Coarse hair appearing on chin, upper lip, chest, abdomen, or back.
facial_hair.moderate_desc: Requires regular tweezing, threading, or waxing

acne.title: Acne and persistent breakouts
acne.desc: Deep, painful, or hormonal pimples along the jawline, chin, or cheeks.
acne.occasional_desc: Occasional mild spots around your period
acne.persistent_desc: Ongoing breakouts along jawline or cheeks
acne.scarring_desc: Breakouts that leave permanent marks or scarring

hair_loss.title: Scalp hair thinning
hair_loss.desc: Thinning on the crown or noticeable widening of your hair parting.
hair_loss.mild_desc: Slight widening at the hair parting
hair_loss.moderate_desc: Noticeable thinning on top of scalp
hair_loss.severe_desc: Significant, diffuse thinning across the scalp
hair_loss.progressive_desc: Rapid shedding or widening in recent months

menstrual.title: Menstrual cycle pattern
menstrual.desc: The spacing and predictability of your periods over the last 12 months.
menstrual.occasionally_irregular_desc: Varies by more than a week once in a while
menstrual.very_infrequent_desc: Only a few periods a year (less than 6-8)
menstrual.no_periods_desc: Absent for 3 or more consecutive months
menstrual.months_amenorrhea: Number of months since your last period
menstrual.hidden_notice: Menstrual cycle questions are hidden because cycle tracking is not applicable to your anatomical context.
menstrual.hormone_note: Hormonal medication can mask your natural cycle, so bleeding is a weak signal for you.

metabolic.title: Metabolic & Physical Health Indicators
metabolic.subtitle: PCOS is closely tied to insulin sensitivity and metabolic balance.
metabolic.bmi_note: Asian-Pacific cutoff guidelines consider BMI ≥ 23 as an indicator for metabolic screening.
metabolic.waist_hint: Measure around your belly button. For Asian women, ≥ 80 cm is a common screening threshold.
metabolic.indicators_title: Check any that apply to you:
metabolic.family_diabetes: Family history of Type 2 Diabetes or heart disease
metabolic.rapid_weight_gain: Recent rapid or unexplained weight changes
metabolic.skin_darkening: Dark velvety patches of skin (e.g. neck, underarms)
metabolic.known_glucose: Previous lab test indicated elevated blood sugar / prediabetes
metabolic.known_lipids: Previous lab test indicated high cholesterol or triglycerides
metabolic.labs_expander_title: I have lab or ultrasound reports (Optional)
metabolic.labs_hint: Leave blank if you haven't had these tests. Ultrasound counts are only needed for clinical dataset resemblance comparison.

wellbeing.title: Emotional Wellbeing & Sleep
wellbeing.subtitle: Hormonal health deeply influences mood, energy, and sleep. These screening modules are completely optional.

sleep_options.0: No sleep problems — rested and energized
sleep_options.1: Mild trouble falling or staying asleep
sleep_options.2: Moderate broken sleep or restless nights
sleep_options.3: Severe difficulty sleeping or daytime exhaustion

wellbeing.optional_mental_toggle: Include validated PHQ-9 & GAD-7 emotional screening
wellbeing.phq_intro: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following?
wellbeing.safety_alert_msg: You indicated thoughts of hurting yourself. Please reach out to someone you trust or contact a crisis professional right now. In India, call the free 24/7 National Mental Health Helpline Tele-MANAS at 14416.
wellbeing.safety_alert_ack: I have read and acknowledged this emergency support information

concern.title: What bothers you the most right now?
concern.subtitle: Choosing your chief concern helps our engine place the most relevant guidance at the very top of your care map.

concerns_list.fertility: Trying to conceive or fertility worries

concern.red_flags_title: Clinical safety check (Check if currently experiencing):
concern.flag_pain: Sudden, severe, or worsening pelvic or abdominal pain
concern.flag_heavy: Heavy bleeding soaking through pads/tampons every hour
concern.flag_postmeno_bleeding: Any vaginal bleeding occurring after menopause

review.title: Review Your Answers
review.subtitle: Confirm your answers before we generate your personalised care map. You can edit any section below.

care_map.not_applicable_title: Areas not applicable to you right now
